title: avd-assess-bundle/v1: the release manifest of the avd-assess map (datapackage.json)
description: A Frictionless Data Package v2 descriptor, generated by scripts/bundle/build_bundle.py from a tagged commit's git blobs, never committed (docs/distribution-spec.md section 4). One resource per file in the bundle with its size and SHA-256; consumers pin the descriptor's own SHA-256, which pins every file. tools/avd_assess_bundle.py and tools/AvdAssessBundle.psm1 check the same rules without a schema library. Readers ignore properties they don't know.

created.description: The tagged commit's committer date (git log -1 --format=%cI), so the manifest rebuilds byte for byte

tag.description: Absent in a dry run; v<version> in a release

schemaString.description: The document's own top-level schema string, repeated

jsonSchema.description: The bundle path of the JSON Schema the document validates against

idPaths.description: JSON pointers (RFC 6901, plus '*' for every array item) to the document's IDs, for tools/diff_bundle.py

path.description: Relative, forward slashes, no '.' or '..' segment, no drive or backslash
